# refusal-format

## Plugin reference

- Description: The text format of a guard's denial — the did-not-run banner, then 'Why it was blocked:' and the guard's own reason — written (joinRefusal) and read back (refusalReason) in one place, so a transcript viewer can show the reason without the banner.
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by:
    - `conversations/conversation-view/jsonl-viewer/tool-call`
    - `framework/tooling/guards`
- Core:
  - Exports (values):
    - `joinRefusal`
    - `REFUSAL_HEADER`
    - `refusalReason`
